structure.overview: The case concerns an appeal by a Ghanaian appellant with US permanent resident status against the Refugee Protection Division's (RPD) decision to exclude him from refugee protection under Article 1E of the IRPA. The appellant argued that the RPD applied the wrong legal test and challenged the finding that he had valid US permanent resident status and no risk or fear in the US. The court reviewed the evidence and legal tests, ultimately dismissing the appeal and agreeing with the RPD that the appellant was properly excluded from refugee protection.
